title: Oven Roasted Australian White Cabbage Paella
description: A winey, fluffy, lazy-Sunday Australian dish featuring white cabbage, caramelize, ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly, cooked in a paella pan. This paella is perfect for a relaxing weekend meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large paella pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the shredded white cabbage and cook until it is slightly caramelized.
Add the white wine, vegetable broth, saffron threads, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then transfer the paella pan to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the cabbage is tender.
Remove the paella pan from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
